title: Map Interchange, Round-Trip, Campaign Atlas, Review, Versions & Publishing
objective: Implement map-specific structured packages and representable flattened/vector outputs, VTI/MAI external interchange, justified GeoJSON-class mapping, print-at-scale output, external-editor round-trip, linked campaign/world atlas packaging, unsupported-semantics retention/loss reporting, map-specific review/conflict projections, and publish/archive adapters over existing ARI/PCA/Packet-07 infrastructure.

scope.purpose: Provide map-specific interchange, round-trip, atlas packaging, review/version projection and publish/archive adapters while preserving ARI/PCA/PDCP owner infrastructure and declared fidelity/loss boundaries.
included: flattened and vector outputs where representable
publish and archive adapters over ARI/PCA/PDCP Packet 07 infrastructure
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS maps can deterministically package, export, round-trip, review/version and publish/archive through map-specific adapters with declared fidelity/loss reporting, provenance and owner infrastructure preserved, without creating replacement ARI/PCA/PDCP authority.

selection_boundaries: MCS-19 completed its map-specific interchange, round-trip, campaign-atlas, fidelity/loss, review/version/conflict and publish/archive adapter scope while ARI/PCA-15/PDCP Packet 07/VTI/MAI remained the shared authorities.

Structured packages may retain unsupported semantics explicitly; flattened/vector/GeoJSON/print derivatives declare representability and loss honestly. External-editor round-trip remained receipt/planning only, and publish/archive adapters performed no network publication or archive mutation.

Independent UISR-01 publication advanced application main during the first all-green MCS-19 validation. The unchanged six-file MCS-19 delta was reconciled onto fresh main and fully revalidated before publication.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3, MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 and PCA_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.4.23 were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-19 publication.

MCS-21 is the MCS family golden-proof tranche and MCS program_edges.golden_proof_requires explicitly names PCA-16. PCA-16 remains planned/unstarted, while CNI-13, PCA-14 and PCA-15 are completed_verified; therefore PCA-16 is the eligible interstitial prerequisite and is selected next without implementation authority.
MCS-21 remains gated until PCA-16 is completed_verified and the DAG is reconsulted. The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
next_action: MCS-19 is closed. PCA-16 is selected_not_started as the required MCS golden-proof interstitial prerequisite; wait for a later owner Continue before granting PCA-16 implementation authority.
